normative_extracts.quote: Using will-change excessively can cause excessive memory consumption and degrade rendering performance.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Each promoted layer allocates a dedicated GPU texture proportional to its pixel area.

production_failures.symptom: Memory crash on iOS Safari across a 100-card grid
production_failures.root_cause: will-change: transform applied to all cards simultaneously.
Promotion to a GPU texture without LCD subpixel antialiasing.
production_failures.mitigation: Avoid permanent layer promotion on static text blocks.
